column1: # ae350-dualpins sub-ledger. Authorised by the orchestrator on 2026-09-07,
# cap 10 oracle runs, because the ae350 ledger had 2 of 8 left and P2.T38
# needs both. One vendor run per row; the open-flow companion of a run is
# not an oracle run and is not counted.
# p2t29-dualpin is VOID: its vehicle (input -> DFF -> LED) cannot reach E1 and
# only a vendor run could show why -- the .tr carries no CLS placement column
# for a design with no register-to-register path. Log kept as
# _runs/p2t29-dualpin-void.log. Three runs; the overrun over the authorised
# ten is these three and is recorded, not absorbed.
